name: Honda CB450
engine: 444 cc air-cooled DOHC parallel twin, torsion bar valve springs, CV carbs
intro: The Black Bomber. Honda's first big twin, with torsion bars in place of coil valve springs.

add.title: Check the torsion bar tension
add.instructions: With the cam covers off, check each valve's torsion bar for equal tension when you remove and refit it. Replace any that are weak.
add.reason: A torsion bar can lose strength if the engine sat for years with that valve held open.

H: Keep each torsion bar, follower and cam part with its own valve. Mixed-up valve gear is a common cause of bad Black Bomber engines.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Tired torsion bars
known.what: Bars can weaken on engines that sat with a valve open.

known.title: Mixed-up valve gear
known.what: Swapped parts between valves cause problems.
